paragraphs.text: Born in the Caribbean, Tobias S. Buckell is a New York Times Bestselling and World Fantasy Award winning author. His novels and almost one hundred stories have been translated into nineteen different languages. He has been nominated for the Hugo Award, Nebula Award, World Fantasy Award, and Astounding Award for Best New Science Fiction Author. He currently lives in Ohio, USA where he teaches Creative Writing at Bluffton University at the Stonecoast MFA in Creative Writing program.
Buckell contributed to the Magic Story for Streets of New Capenna .
